design_probes.minimal_case: One real local environment initialization, four synthetic asymmetric replay rows, one critic update, one actor update, one full checkpoint save-load, and 21 tiny-payload lifecycle saves through the same bound gateway.

live_only_unknowns.fact: On the server, the official CUDA learner and MuJoCo collector subprocess complete the first CPU-pinned double-buffer transfer and one finite privileged SAC update under the v012 source profile.
live_only_unknowns.why_offline_impossible: The local audit has no server CUDA device and deliberately replaces the collector subprocess with synthetic replay rows; it cannot establish CUDA compilation, device transfer, subprocess lifecycle, or the first live rollout transaction.
live_only_unknowns.falsifier: Collector startup failure, wrong 98/303/29 tensors, pinned-transfer failure, non-finite first learner metrics, child-process death, or any write outside the fresh audit directory.
live_only_unknowns.cost: One server GPU, a fresh isolated audit directory, and at most 120 seconds; stop after the first finite update or first invariant failure.
live_only_unknowns.stop_condition: Stop immediately after the first finite collector-to-learner update is logged, at 120 seconds, or on the first identity lifecycle or numeric failure; do not continue the Oracle campaign.
live_only_unknowns.bounded_command: cd /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal && AUDIT_DIR=$(mktemp -d /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/.v012-formal-XXXXXX) && timeout 120s env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ICE_CAL_ORACLE_LINEAGE_ID=formal-live-v012 PYTHONPATH=/ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/src uv run --no-sync python scripts/train_offpolicy.py algo=sac task=sac/g1_walk_flat/mujoco_fada_privileged_oracle training.device=cuda:0 training.log_dir=$AUDIT_DIR
live_only_unknowns.zero_write_boundary: Only the newly created /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal/.v012-formal-* directory may be written; no existing checkpoint log config source or repository file may change.

claims.scope: The official local configuration and real MuJoCo initialization compose through replay into one finite actor and critic update with the pinned 98/303/29 identity.
Canonical schema-2 state strictly round-trips before mutation and the bound production gateway finalizes exactly one 20+1 lineage.

negative_scope: No server CUDA collector transaction, long training, convergence, locomotion quality, Unit B readiness, commit, push, or deployment is claimed.
LIVE_REQUIRED is not permission to execute the bounded server command; it requires separate human authorization.
The local MuJoCo initialization and synthetic replay update do not prove 5000-iteration stability or privileged Oracle quality.
